text:
Maya R.: quick one — new candidate (verdant-60b-qlt) landed in the intake queue. Quant smoke showed a 7% drop on summarization F1 after 4-bit quant. can we decide if this gets a high-priority re-quant vs park to backlog?
Eli: do we have the exact eval diffs? 7% is rough — which prompt set?
Maya R.: using internal/summaries-v2 small subset. here's the head of diff: ```before: F1 0.781
after:  F1 0.726
mean token time: before 12ms -> after 9ms```
Sam W.: tradeoff looks plausible to me if latency gain matters. but we should check hallucination regression (precision down?).
Priya: prioritization rubric rec: if quality delta >5% on core eval AND impacts hallucination, mark P0 for ML to debug quant params. otherwise P2.
Eli: i can run drift eval across 10k samples tonight. if hallucination spike <2% we can accept and push to dedicated canary with A/B.
Maya R.: goal is to cap token-cost by 30% on hosted. dedicated capacity ramp depends on SLA. if we accept slightly lower f1 we'll need regression alert flagging per-route.
Sam W.: checklist: 1) re-run quant with per-channel scaling 2) try 6-bit QAT 3) run targeted hallucination eval 4) schedule canary on dedicated pool
Priya: agree. adding gating note: require rollback policy + fallback to fp16 variant automatically if live eval error rate >1% in 10m window.
Kai (ops-bot): deploy-checklist created: #deploys/verdant-quant-canary -> template attached (ops link) :white_check_mark:
Maya R.: ok tagging this as P0 for this sprint. Eli, can you post drift results by EOD? Sam/ML please attempt 6-bit QAT on monday.
Eli: on it. will update in thread with a tiny CSV summary.
Sam W.: started an experiment run id: exp-176999-verdant-q6. i'll paste logs if it looks promising. :rocket:
Priya: adding to roadmap board under "quant ops — critical" and assigning dev slot week 3.
Maya R.: thanks — i'll also add a short prompt set for regression alerts. will follow up with rollout policy in console. :thumbsup:
